Generalized Logic and Framework Documentation:
・Expand and document the product’s underlying logic to support tracking and alerting for any Cardano Native Token across Twitter, Telegram, and Discord. This includes detailing how the bot flow and data parsing mechanisms are adapted for multi-token support.
・Provide a comprehensive PDF document that includes:
・A step-by-step explanation of the logic generalization process.
・A working diagram/flowchart illustrating the integration of multi-token support and how the system processes these tokens across different platforms.
・An overview of the changes made to the initial single-token alert system to accommodate multiple tokens.

Functional Demonstrations and Specifications:
・Demonstrate the system’s functionality with at least three different Cardano Native Tokens. This includes showing successful alerts being posted on Twitter, Telegram, and Discord.
・Include detailed functional specifications within the PDF document, covering the generalized system’s capabilities and its adaptability for future expansions.
ms.criteria:
Multi-Token Event Detection:
・The system must successfully detect events for at least three different Cardano Native Tokens, based on DEX events and existing subscription settings.
